# RESOURCES.md Format

Use `RESOURCES.md` to list sources for the teaching topic. Give each source
a link or location, a short description, and the lesson that needs it.

```md
# {Topic} Resources

## Knowledge

- [{Source title}]({URL}) — {What it explains and when to use it.}

## Communities

- {Community and location} — {What practice or feedback it offers.}

## Gaps

- {Information still needed.}
```

Prefer primary sources and current expert work. Check each source before
you recommend it. Remove a source when it is wrong or no longer relevant.
Record a user's choice not to join a community.
